item.meridian_undead.spawn_egg.tooltip: Use on a spawner to set which zombie it spawns.
effect.meridian_undead.bronze_hide.descr: Direct strikes spare skin and bone, while fire and spells still pierce.
technique.meridian_undead.leap.note: The corpse borrows its leg meridians and vaults toward warm flesh.
technique.meridian_undead.bronze_hide.no: Breath from the corpse pearl climbs through the bones and hardens the flesh against blows.
codex.source.meridian_undead.corpse_move: The art comes to a corpse as its meridians open. No scroll is known to pass from hand to hand.
book.meridian_undead.corpse_arts.note: It records how a ruined body may still borrow its bones to move.
volume.meridian_undead.corpse_movement.n: Open leg meridians let the corpse leap. Open arm meridians bring bronze hide. These pages cannot open a single meridian for it.
message.meridian_undead.weak_legs: Your legs are too weak to leap
